items.title: Check by mail
items.body: PLACEHOLDER — make checks payable to Ty’s Future Stars Foundation and post them to the address below.
items.detail: PLACEHOLDER — mailing address, Smyrna, TN. Confirm the exact postal address before publishing.

items.title: Employer matching
items.body: PLACEHOLDER — many employers match employee donations, often dollar for dollar. Check with your HR team.
items.detail: PLACEHOLDER — what the donor should send us so we can complete a match request.

items.title: Donor-advised fund
items.body: PLACEHOLDER — recommend a grant to us through your donor-advised fund.
items.detail: PLACEHOLDER — the legal name and EIN a DAF sponsor will ask for.

items.title: Gifts of stock
items.body: PLACEHOLDER — giving appreciated securities can be more tax-efficient than giving cash.
items.detail: PLACEHOLDER — brokerage name, DTC number, and account number. Confirm before publishing.

items.detail: PLACEHOLDER — the current needs list and where to drop items off.
